The company exhibits a strong balance sheet with substantial equity ($2,858M), a solid working capital position (current ratio of ~2.57x), and a moderate leverage ratio (Total Liabilities / Total Assets of ~58.7%). However, profitability margins are relatively thin, with an operating margin of ~6.4% and net income of $32M yielding a low Return on Assets (~0.46%). Based on solid solvency and liquidity balanced against modest overall profitability, the issuer warrants a solid investment-grade rating.

DECISION: BBB
